Values._README2: In Azure, the function will use these managed identity settings:
Values._README4: For local development, uncomment and configure these connection strings:
Values._README4B: DataverseSchemaPrefix: Customize the Dataverse table/field prefix (default: 'mcicaps')
Values._README4C: Underscore is automatically appended if not present. Example: 'mcicaps' becomes 'mcicaps_'
Values._README4D: You can also set it with underscore: 'mcicaps_' will be used as-is
Values._README4F: Direct Line URLs are now configured in Dataverse in the agenttoeval table
Values._README4G: No local configuration is needed - URLs are dynamically retrieved per evaluation run
Values._README4H1: MaxRequestsPerSecond: Sustainable rate (staging: 5, range: 5-20 depending on tier)
Values._README4H2: BurstCapacity: Allow short bursts (staging: 5, recommended: 1.5x-3x MaxRequestsPerSecond)
Values._README4H3: MaxConcurrentRequests: Parallel limit (staging: 5, range: 5-100, 0=unlimited NOT recommended)
Values._README5A: MaxNoProgressMinutes: Progress-based timeout - marks evaluation as stalled if no progress for this duration (staging: 240 minutes)
Values._README5A1: NOTE: MaxRunningTimeMinutes has been REMOVED - evaluations now run indefinitely as long as they make progress
Values._README5B_OLD: StalePendingThresholdMinutes: Detects stalled pending results with no completion (staging: 30 minutes)
Values._README5B: Note: Monitors LastProgressUpdate on evaluation run to avoid false positives during legitimate queue delays
Values._README5B2: MaxRetryAttempts: Number of times to retry failed agent calls or evaluations before marking errored (staging: 10)
Values._README5B3: RetryDelaySeconds: Base delay between retries in seconds, uses exponential backoff (staging: 30)
Values._README5C: RandomDelay: Adds 5000-45000ms random delay at worker start to stagger load (set both to 0 to disable)
Values._README5D: Higher delay range (vs ms) prevents thundering herd when many concurrent evaluations start simultaneously
Values._README6B: maxConcurrentCalls: Max messages processed concurrently per instance (staging: 5, range: 1-100)
Values._README6C: With 30 instances @ 5 concurrent = 150 max system-wide; lower value reduces Copilot Studio throttling
Values._README6D: maxConcurrentSessions: For session-enabled queues (not currently used)
Values._README6E: prefetchCount: 0=disable prefetch to prevent memory issues with large messages
Values._README6F: WEBSITE_MAX_DYNAMIC_APPLICATION_SCALE_OUT: Max instances for consumption plan (default: 200, recommended: 5-10 for rate limiting)
Values._README8: 1. Copy this file to local.settings.json in the AiAgentEvaluation folder
Values._README9: 2. Remove the underscore prefix from the settings you want to use for local development
Values._README10: 3. Replace placeholder values with your actual configuration
Values._README11: 4. For Copilot Studio: Remove underscore from _CopilotStudio:TokenEndpoint and update with your URL
Values._README12: 5. The function will automatically fall back to connection strings when managed identity is not available
